description:
View registration status, balance summary, and the Authority's Nostr npub.

When an explicit ``npub`` is provided, requires a Schnorr proof of
ownership — without it, anyone could enumerate balances by walking
the community registry. When ``npub`` is empty, falls back to the
Authority's own operator identity and skips the proof check (self-
inspection is always allowed).

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: Nostr public key (npub1...). Defaults to operator identity if empty.

name: authority_operator_status
title: Operator status
